supersedes: Prior research objectives, fitness and finalist criteria only; frozen historical runs remain immutable evidence.

units.returns_cagr_drawdown_concentration: fractions; 1.5 means 150 percent CAGR; drawdown is a nonnegative loss magnitude
units.turnover: annual sum of absolute executed notional changes divided by pre-fill equity; both rotation legs
units.cost_drag: annual sum of fees, slippage and funding debits divided by pre-charge equity; credits disclosed separately

targets.above_target_cagr: Do not reject above 200 percent; apply the same audits and report separately as above target.

robust.objective: Highest causal out-of-sample CAGR under the drawdown and exposure caps; retain lower-return Pareto alternatives.
robust.quality_targets: Report Sharpe, Calmar and fold targets even when missed; B is best robust candidate, not a claim of meeting the high-return goal.

aggressive.objective: Search for 150-200 percent OOS CAGR; lower-CAGR feasible candidates remain available for Pareto comparison.

exposure_rules.volatility_inputs: Only completed bars available before the order; rising volatility must reduce, never mechanically increase, the risk budget.
exposure_rules.enforcement: Check aggregate gross notional/equity, including partial fills and price drift, at every simulated event; record breaches, margin and liquidation events. No missing-price liquidation exemption.

fitness.development_selection: Use inner validation only. Separate populations, search budgets, Pareto fronts and registries by mode and exposure cap; never train or select with outer OOS or sealed results.
fitness.frozen_nominees: Freeze A, B and C nominees and tie-breaks before opening sealed data. A: among eligible development Pareto candidates, prioritize target DD then acceptable DD, then Calmar, Sharpe, CAGR, lower turnover, lexical ID. B: highest CAGR on robust feasible Pareto front, then smaller DD, lower turnover, lexical ID. C: highest Calmar on the combined feasible development Pareto front, then smaller DD, Sharpe, lower turnover, lexical ID. These are disclosed tie-breaks, not a scalar fitness.
fitness.final_comparison: OOS/sealed Pareto fronts describe the frozen candidates only; no reselection, retries or parameter tuning after seeing them. A failing sealed nominee is not replaced by another using the same seal.

evaluation_protocol.oos: Chronological, non-overlapping outer walk-forward test intervals; all selection inside prior train/validation data. Purge overlapping labels/holding horizons and embargo as predeclared. Include cash and losing folds, not only active/profitable folds.
evaluation_protocol.sealed: Untouched evaluation opened once after freezing candidates and selection. Previously inspected repository history cannot be retroactively sealed; use independently uninspected or prospective data. Seal access and all trials must be logged.
evaluation_protocol.metrics: Net simulated account returns, including all costs and cash bars. CAGR uses elapsed UTC years (365.25 days); MDD includes starting equity and intrabar event equity; daily Sharpe uses sample standard deviation, 365.25 periods/year and zero cash/risk-free rate. Calmar = CAGR / positive MDD. Invalid/non-finite metrics fail closed.
evaluation_protocol.gate_scope: Apply numeric high-return risk/stress/concentration gates independently to stitched outer OOS and sealed evaluation; fold profitability and worst-fold loss use outer WF folds. This scope is fixed before evaluation.
evaluation_protocol.fold_profit: Net compounded fold return strictly above zero; zero-return folds are not profitable.
evaluation_protocol.remove_best_day: Replace the highest net UTC daily return by zero, retain all dates and annualization denominator, compound the remaining daily returns.
evaluation_protocol.remove_best_trades: Rank complete flat-to-flat position episodes by reconciled log-growth contribution. Combine partial exits/reentries within the declared episode rule; never split a winner into child fills. Remove the top three episode contributions, retain the calendar and reconcile remaining growth; do not retune the strategy.
evaluation_protocol.log_attribution: Use reconciled additive log-growth attribution by concrete asset and complete position episode, summing to total net log growth. Share = positive contribution / total net log growth, not sum of positive contributions; nonpositive total growth is invalid. Overlapping positions require an explicit reconciled allocation convention.
evaluation_protocol.double_cost: Rerun fills/accounting with 2x fees, 2x adverse slippage and 2x funding debits; do not double funding credits to improve stress results. Report signed-2x funding sensitivity separately if relevant. Preserve strategy parameters and model margin/size feedback.
evaluation_protocol.delay: Rerun with each entry delayed by one additional realizable bar after its normal causal fill; no backward fills, no new information injected into the frozen decision. Report skipped/expired signals and changed position state.
evaluation_protocol.neighbors: Freeze adjacent parameter values, coverage and numeric similarity tolerances before results. Rerun neighbors on the same causal protocol; missing/preselected favorable neighbors cannot pass.
evaluation_protocol.missing_evidence: unverified; never zero, pass, or a successful finalist
evaluation_protocol.realistic_boundary: Report only the observed feasible frontier of the tested universe, period, parameter space and cost/fill assumptions; do not present it as a proven global attainable limit. State numerical cost in drawdown, concentration, turnover and robustness for higher return.

extended_audit_rule: Automatically request and run every extended check when any development/OOS/sealed CAGR reaches 150 percent, including values above 200 percent. Block finalist status until all evidence exists and passes. The evaluator reports missing checks; the replay/audit runner must execute them, never auto-fill pass flags.

risk_research.trailing_boundary: Monotonic toward profit only; completed-bar information; never widen after TP or restart.
risk_research.reentry: Confirmed rebound from completed data with per-position cooldown/hysteresis; no averaging down during a continuing decline.
risk_research.rotation_priority: Normal rotation into a new target immediately supersedes the old position's stop, TP, cooldown and reentry state. Close old position and reset state; do not block a new target.

verdicts.A: Frozen high-return nominee passed every OOS and sealed gate and extended audit; report 150-200 percent or above-target result explicitly.
verdicts.B: Best frozen robust nominee at maximum 1.25x and maximum 25 percent drawdown; no 150 percent CAGR floor.
verdicts.C: Frozen feasible Pareto compromise; disclose missed main targets and every tradeoff.
verdicts.D: No validated high-return winner when A fails or evidence is missing; explain invalid leverage, concentration, leakage, overfitting or insufficient evidence. D can coexist with B and C.
